definition.description: Same template as sample_wap_static, but a generator step running in a container returns the step list as maestro_expansion.

value: echo table=$$TABLE; echo step_inputs=$$STEP_INPUTS; echo template=$$TEMPLATE_IDENTITY; echo "$$MAESTRO_OUTPUT_START"; echo '{"params": {"maestro_expansion": {"type": "STRING", "value": "{\"steps\": [{\"step\": {\"id\": \"audit\", \"type\": \"NoOp\", \"params\": {\"total\": {\"type\": \"LONG\", \"expression\": \"long t = 0; for (int i = 0; i < writes__row_count.length; i += 1) { t = t + writes__row_count[i]; } return t;\"}}, \"transition\": {\"successors\": {\"publish\": \"true\"}}}}, {\"step\": {\"id\": \"publish\", \"type\": \"NoOp\", \"params\": {\"snapshot\": {\"type\": \"STRING\", \"expression\": \"'"'"'snapshot-'"'"' + table;\"}}}}], \"params\": {\"branch\": {\"type\": \"STRING\", \"value\": \"generated\"}}}", "evaluated_result": "{\"steps\": [{\"step\": {\"id\": \"audit\", \"type\": \"NoOp\", \"params\": {\"total\": {\"type\": \"LONG\", \"expression\": \"long t = 0; for (int i = 0; i < writes__row_count.length; i += 1) { t = t + writes__row_count[i]; } return t;\"}}, \"transition\": {\"successors\": {\"publish\": \"true\"}}}}, {\"step\": {\"id\": \"publish\", \"type\": \"NoOp\", \"params\": {\"snapshot\": {\"type\": \"STRING\", \"expression\": \"'"'"'snapshot-'"'"' + table;\"}}}}], \"params\": {\"branch\": {\"type\": \"STRING\", \"value\": \"generated\"}}}", "evaluated_time": 1}}}'; echo "$$MAESTRO_OUTPUT_END"
